2125391596678180982.en_summary: @firesidealpha: Ray Dalio says investors mistake great technology for a great investment in a bubble and compares the AI boom with the innovations of the 1920s. Bubble is not just price beyond PV of future cash flows because future cash flows unknown for decades.
2125391596678180982.zh_summary: @firesidealpha：Ray Dalio 指投資者在泡沫中將偉大技術誤認為偉大投資，並將 AI 繁榮與 1920 年代創新比較。泡沫不只是價格超過未來現金流現值，因為未來現金流幾十年未知。
